subject: Torchline: Benchmark request + replacement signal
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@torchline.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@torchline.com
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial benchmark request + replacement talk

Markus —

Thanks for the chat earlier. To be direct: our infra team surfaced a clear cost/latency gap vs a vendor called LanternAI. They're asking us to run a short side-by-side for our highest-throughput model (seq_len 1024, p50 latency target 70ms) and will evaluate inference cost at 1B tokens/month.

Can Redwood run a 72-hour benchmark with our sample workload and provide:
- p50/p95 latency distributions by token batch size
- token cost estimate (production-config)
- any recommended dedicated capacity configs you think mirror our scale

Procurement cc'd — if this looks like a renewal risk we'll need a proposal including committed capacity pricing and any migration-safety commitments.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Director of ML Engineering, Torchline

Attachment: torchline-benchmark-specs.csv (CSV)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@torchline.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial benchmark request + replacement talk

Hi Elena — really appreciate the frankness, and sorry to hear LanternAI is in the mix. We can absolutely run a targeted 72-hour side-by-side. Quick callouts up front so we scope correctly:

- We can mirror your seq_len and request mix; Naomi (CS Ops) will coordinate the run and collect p50/p95.
- For a credible cost number we'll run both hosted instances and a Dedicated pilot (3 GPU nodes) so you can compare unit economics and latency SLOs.
- We can provide a temporary pricing anchor for a 12-month committed capacity offer if needed.

Next steps: Naomi will set the ramp plan and share a test token for traffic. Can we start the bench on Monday 2027-10-18?

Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Torchline bench — plan and ask (internal)

Markus — forwarding Elena's specs. Proposed quick plan:

1) Pre-bench (Fri 10/15): confirm traffic profile, create test client keys, validate dataset.
2) Bench (Mon 10/18 — Wed 10/20): run 72 hours, 3x scenarios: hosted baseline, dedicated 3xA40 pilot, and a quantized vCPU-friendly run for cost check.
3) Post-bench (Thu 10/21): assemble p50/p95, token cost by scenario, and a concise recommendation (1-pg) + up to 3 pricing options (commit/consumption/short-term pilot).

Ops caveat: we should instrument KV cache warm-up to reflect Torchline's long-prefix usage or numbers will look artificially low.

Who owns the 1-pg outcome? Suggest Laura draft and Rishi provide kernel/quantization notes.

Naomi

--
Internal only — recipients are all Redwood staff
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Torchline bench — plan and ask (internal)

Agree with the plan. Technical notes to include in the bench runbook:
- Use 8-token micro-batching and 32-token macro-window to reproduce Torchline's p50 distribution.
- Enable prefix/KV cache to start after 30 minutes of steady traffic; capture cold/warm curves.
- Run quantized INT4 variant for dedicated nodes and measure quality delta using their evaluation set (we should ask for a small eval subset).

Also recommend we surface a 'migration-sidecar' offer: a 6-week dual-run where we keep a routed percentage and offer a rollback SLA (data plane routing + fallbacks) — this materially reduces migration risk and is a strong save lever.

Rishi
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@torchline.com>, procurement@torchline.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial benchmark request + replacement talk

Elena — we're set to start tomorrow (Monday 10/18) at 09:00 PT. Quick notes so expectations are aligned:

- We'll run the three scenarios Naomi outlined (hosted, dedicated 3xA40, quantized pilot).
- Expect a preliminary p50/p95 snapshot after 24 hours and a full deliverable after 72 hours.
- If Torchline can share a 2k-sample eval set (anonymized) we'll include quality comparisons for the quantized run.
- Post-bench we'll propose a 12-month committed uplift + an optional 6-week migration-sidecar (zero-downtime routing + rollback SLA).

I'm attaching a short pricing worksheet so procurement has something to work with during the bench.

Thanks,
Markus

Attachment: pricing-worksheet.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@torchline.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@torchline.com, Samir Shah <samir@lanternai.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial benchmark request + replacement talk

Markus — thanks, that timeline works. Procurement wants the dedicated pilot numbers in writing before we begin; Samir (LanternAI) is cc'd and said they'd match pricing for a 12-month commit. Two asks before we start:

1) Please confirm the exact dedicated node spec and expected p50 improvement vs hosted baseline (ballpark numbers are fine up front).
2) Add language to the migration-sidecar that we can run in parallel with LanternAI for up to 4 weeks (so procurement can see live A/B traffic) and include a rollback SLA.

We'll upload the small eval subset to the Drive link and procurement will confirm PO terms if the bench results look favorable.

-Elena
